title: AIDEAL semantic pipeline reference
scope: Portable treatment development, matched-condition evaluation, three-README evaluation and native documentation development. No machine-local study results are included.

prompt_resolution.current_comparison: Inline workflow.evaluation_setup.SYSTEM, workflow.evaluation.audience_prompt and workflow.condition_context.public_context; see docs/SUMMARY.md.
prompt_resolution.flat_prompt_directory: Reference/preview assets; not automatically the legacy aideal/<name>.md override layout.

compatibility_facades.readme_agent: Existing aideal.readme_agent names explicitly reexport split implementation functions.
compatibility_facades.doc_checks: Existing aideal.doc_checks names explicitly reexport split implementation functions.

stages.title: Validate three-README inputs
stages.harness: None; configuration inspection does not execute commands.
limitations: Input documents and independently designed tasks must already exist.
Evaluation-block paths use the YAML directory; bank reference/oracle paths use the bank directory.

stages.title: Execute independent checker controls
stages.harness: readme_evaluation.adapter.command; correct, wrong-output and optional no-target-call controls
limitations: Private oracle paths and reference code are trusted-checker inputs only.
Infrastructure failures get a new attempt on explicit retry; verified semantic failures remain cached.
Controls test declared behaviors, not universal oracle validity.

stages.title: Freeze and verify study identity
stages.harness: No new execution in open_frozen; freeze_evaluation invokes controls.
limitations: Changed controller/artifact identities require fresh validation and freeze.
Review holds block control validation and evaluation.

stages.title: Select documentation and generate matched solutions
stages.harness: readme_evaluation.model.command; included Google SDK adapter; no library execution here
limitations: Receives public task/contract/docs and permitted retry feedback; no hidden oracle/reference fields.
This path uses inline prompts, not aideal.prompts.load.
Same audience model handles initial solutions and snippet repairs.

stages.title: Execute solutions and bounded snippet repairs
stages.harness: readme_evaluation.adapter.command; independent outputs and target-API use checks
stages.role: same audience on permitted repair rounds
limitations: Execution, oracle and target flags all must pass.
Infrastructure errors remain unresolved; adapter-specific runtime behavior requires independent validation.
Source/readiness checks do not prove that an arbitrary adapter selected the intended runtime.

stages.title: Resume, score and compare conditions
stages.harness: None; reads recorded outcomes.
limitations: Unresolved outcomes remain in the selected denominator.
Pass needs execution_pass, oracle_pass and target_reached.
Completed unit checkpoints are not fully hash-bound back to complete attempt evidence.

stages.title: Discover API scope and intent
stages.harness: Source/test discovery from legacy YAML; no native execution required.
outputs: Intent caches and recorded classifier prompts
limitations: Declaration count is not automatically the scientific API denominator.
readme_agent retains compatible public imports.

stages.title: Author grounded README entries
stages.harness: Optional probe_on_missing invokes development probes; ordinary authoring reads source/tests/docs.
limitations: Generates treatment candidates; does not create held-out task oracles.
Provider failures can leave clearly incomplete entry skeletons.
Prompt lookup supports project overrides before packaged defaults.

stages.title: Generate execution scaffold and inputs
stages.harness: comprehension.execute.scaffold/frame, imports, sample_data, insertion region, build/command/runtime settings
stages.role: author only for optional auto preamble/I/O hints
limitations: Generated harnesses remain library-specific and need validation.
Automatic preamble/I/O helpers use inline model prompts.

stages.title: LLM-grade documentation comprehension
stages.harness: execute=False; no native code execution
outputs: Comprehension snippet, model judgment and report
limitations: Model grading is not runtime proof or independent semantic correctness.

stages.title: Execute documentation-derived snippets
stages.harness: comprehension.execute scaffold/build/command with native marker/error checks
stages.role: audience first attempt; fixer on retries
limitations: Native exit/marker rules are not automatically independent scientific oracles.
First attempt avoids previous-failure hints; retry receives permitted failure context.
Split implementation code changes invalidate prior fingerprints.

stages.title: Source-assisted development diagnosis
stages.harness: None in diagnosis itself; reads available source/type/call-site/failure evidence.
limitations: Source-informed development context must not leak into held-out audience requests.

stages.title: Repair persistent README and recheck
stages.harness: Rechecks new documentation via comprehension_check under configured execution settings.
stages.role: fixer diagnoses/rewrites; audience/fixer for recheck snippets
outputs: Repair journal and locked document updates
limitations: Document rounds differ from snippet fixes and provider retries.
Unsuccessful repairs can restore the original entry; a development pass is not a held-out score.

stages.title: Generate task candidates and development probes
stages.harness: Probe-specific execution context; candidate task generation itself does not execute an oracle.
stages.role: author for tasks; audience for LLM probes
limitations: Candidates need independent oracle/fixture validation before evaluation admission.

stages.title: Invoke application-owned puzzle evaluator
stages.harness: puzzle.command, selected plan/document/scaffold, runner arguments; optional PUZZLE_HINTS
stages.role: audience provider/model identity forwarded to external runner
limitations: Prompts and correctness semantics belong to the configured application runner.
This is separate from workflow.run_evaluation's held-out bank.

stages.title: Attach five identical baseline worktrees
stages.harness: Configured harness, configured frame or templates/harness language skeleton, copied identically
limitations: No model call, treatment application or measured result.
Bank begins empty; scaffolds marked evaluation_ready=false.
Source-glob/repository check occurs after output creation and can leave a partial study.

stages.title: Inspect legacy offline five-arm helpers
stages.harness: Legacy offline integrity and scoring helpers; execution uses condition_freeze and condition_run.
outputs: Offline integrity, routing and scoring helper results
limitations: Legacy run-arm intentionally refuses implicit study execution; use freeze-conditions and run-conditions.
Historical offline records are not automatically migrated into condition_evaluation_v1.
Five treatment arms do not isolate all three-factor interactions.

stages.title: Preview source and development failures
stages.harness: Static source parsing only; never imports target code.
outputs: preview.json with selected API/source/error context and input hashes
Library manifest, bounded per-batch previews and complete scope accounting
limitations: Only explicitly selected development errors; known held-out labels rejected, unlabelled logs require operator selection.
Default 12 APIs and 60,000 context characters; source windows may include whole small files.

stages.title: Suggest aliases and function fix hints
stages.harness: Configured development model via execution.invoke; bounded per-batch calls with exact saved request/response and resume identities.
stages.role: Explicit development-model config, independent of audience evaluation
outputs: Hash-bound proposal.json, optionally containing an already generated README
limitations: Ordinary README generation is separate; a supplied README is bundled, not sent to this model.
Hint predicates must match cited development errors for the same function.
No behavior validation, human approval or evaluated fix is inferred.

stages.title: Install and version treatment branches
stages.harness: No runtime harness; raw Git blobs and explicit local commits, with hooks/filters disabled.
outputs: Applicable attached source files and branch commits
Resumable journal, immutable application.json and current.json
limitations: Complete bundle: omitted treatments remove only previous AIDEAL-owned files; Original remains unchanged.
Combined reuses identical artifact bytes; installing does not establish model exposure.
Library validation and separate evaluation approval are still required; review holds are respected.

stages.title: Suggest and compare duplicate-function refactors
stages.harness: Static Python AST or partial Scala/Java/Rust lexical extraction; no models, target imports or tests.
outputs: Duplicate-candidate groups, locations, input hashes and recommended checks
Compatible before/after counts and reduction, or explicit non-comparable result
limitations: Scanner/model outputs are review candidates; install-refactor versions an explicit replacement manifest separately, still requiring behavior validation.
Preserve public APIs; structural matches do not prove semantic equivalence.
Near duplicates and alpha-renamed functions are outside this scanner.

stages.title: Validate and freeze each treatment backend
stages.harness: Per-condition independent reference, wrong-output and no-target controls
limitations: A valid library adapter/build, development separation and independent bank are explicit inputs.
Synthetic software checks are not hosted-model experimental results.

stages.title: Evaluate matched treatment conditions
stages.harness: Per-condition backend-aware adapter; canonical targets and independent oracles
limitations: A valid library adapter/build, development separation and independent bank are explicit inputs.
Synthetic software checks are not hosted-model experimental results.

stages.title: Compare matched scores and resources
stages.harness: No execution; reuse verified results
limitations: A valid library adapter/build, development separation and independent bank are explicit inputs.
Synthetic software checks are not hosted-model experimental results.

review_paths.title: Treatment evaluation
review_paths.subtitle: Five arms, refactor pair or six arms
review_paths.summary: Main matched treatment path: compare exact documentation, alias, hint and source versions on one shared task bank.
review_paths.note: Validation executes controls on every backend. Hints appear only after checked failures; outputs remain bound to the frozen protocol.

entries.title: Freeze the condition study
entries.inputs: Explicit frozen/source/artifact identities and shared bank
entries.outputs: Validated evidence or an explicit unresolved state

entries.title: Generate, execute and verify
entries.inputs: Explicit frozen/source/artifact identities and shared bank
entries.outputs: Validated evidence or an explicit unresolved state

entries.title: Read matched scores
entries.inputs: Explicit frozen/source/artifact identities and shared bank
entries.outputs: Validated evidence or an explicit unresolved state

review_paths.title: Development
review_paths.subtitle: Generate documentation and propose source treatments
review_paths.summary: Review README development first. Expand the additional tools for source-grounded alias proposals, fix hints, treatment commits and duplicate-refactor suggestions.
review_paths.note: This is a separate development workflow. Documentation is supplied explicitly to evaluation; installed aliases and hints still need library validation and runtime integration.

entries.title: Inspect API scope
entries.summary: Extract candidate API signatures, visibility and identities from the configured sources.

entries.title: Generate README
entries.summary: Use source, tests and original documentation to author API entries.
entries.inputs: API scope, source/test evidence, documentation and author model

entries.title: Check documentation examples
entries.summary: Write examples and route them to model grading or configured native execution.
entries.inputs: Documentation, audience model and optional execution harness
entries.outputs: Snippets and grading or execution records

entries.title: Diagnose and repair README
entries.summary: Diagnose development failures, rewrite affected entries, and recheck them.
entries.inputs: Failed development cases and source/document context
entries.outputs: Journaled document changes and repair report

review_paths.title: Attach and prepare a library
review_paths.subtitle: Attach and validate a concrete library
review_paths.summary: Branch and treatment preparation are implemented. Library-specific builds, fixtures and independent oracles remain explicit inputs.
review_paths.note: Creating branches or passing a readiness check does not prove the README, alias and error-hint treatments exist or have been evaluated.

entries.title: Prepare a study draft
entries.summary: Snapshot configured inputs and create the initial shared study records.
entries.outputs: Draft plan, empty task bank and condition folders

entries.title: Create five worktrees
entries.summary: Prepare the study and create isolated branches from one pinned clean revision.
entries.inputs: Clean Git repository, engine YAML and destination
entries.outputs: Five worktrees, attachment records and harness scaffolds

entries.title: Inspect readiness
entries.summary: List missing requirements for the declared bank, treatments and adapter.
entries.inputs: Plan, bank, treatments, validation and approval records

entries.title: Choose the matched condition runner
entries.summary: Use run-conditions with an explicit frozen protocol; legacy run-arm does not select a study.
entries.inputs: Frozen condition study and separate output directory

review_paths.title: Three-README comparison
review_paths.subtitle: One backend, three documentation versions
review_paths.summary: Read this separate protocol when comparing Original, Generated and Repaired README versions.
review_paths.note: Documents and an independent task bank must already exist. This protocol does not reinterpret condition-study evidence.

entries.title: Validate and freeze
entries.summary: Check the study inputs and independent checker controls, then record their identities.
entries.inputs: Study YAML, three document bundles, task bank and adapters

entries.title: Run or resume comparison
entries.summary: Choose documentation, request fresh solutions, check them, and allow bounded snippet repairs.
entries.inputs: Frozen study and an output directory
entries.outputs: Saved requests, process records and per-task results

entries.title: Understand the scores
entries.summary: Compare matched outcomes while retaining unresolved tasks in the denominator.
entries.inputs: Frozen study and saved result rows
entries.outputs: Paired metrics; write_report saves REPORT.md and report.json
